result.instructions: Tools for ipdata, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Where is the IP address 8.8.8.8 located, and which network does it belong to?"; "Is 185.220.101.1 a known Tor exit node or a threat?"; "Which company owns the IP address 17.253.144.10?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ipdata data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ipdata_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ipdata_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ipdata_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ipdata_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ipdata_lookup_ip
tools.title: Look up an IP address
tools.description: Geolocation and network data for one IP address: city, region, country, continent, coordinates, postal code, time zone, currency, languages, mobile carrier, ASN, plus company and threat data where the key's plan includes them. Pass `fields` to get only some of it. The reply also carries `count`, the requests this key made in the last 24 hours. GET /{ip}. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

ip.description: A public IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example 8.8.8.8. Required: ipdata never looks up this server's own address.

fields.description: Only these top-level fields (for example ["ip", "country_name", "asn"]). Omit for the full reply that the key's plan includes.

tools.name: ipdata_get_threat
tools.title: Get threat data for an IP address
tools.description: Threat profile of one IP address: is_tor, is_proxy, is_anonymous, is_datacenter, is_known_attacker, is_known_abuser, is_threat, is_bogon, is_icloud_relay and the blocklists it appears on. Business and Enterprise plans also get is_vpn and reputation scores (vpn, proxy, threat and trust, 0-100). GET /{ip}/threat. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

ip.description: A public IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example 8.8.8.8. Required: ipdata never looks up this server's own address.

annotations.title: Get threat data for an IP address

ip.description: A public IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example 8.8.8.8. Required: ipdata never looks up this server's own address.

tools.name: ipdata_lookup_asn
tools.title: Look up an AS number
tools.description: Details of one autonomous system: organisation, domain, usage type, IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes, number of IPs, registry, country, allocation date, status, and upstream, downstream and peer AS numbers. GET /AS{number}. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

asn.description: An AS number, for example AS15169 or 15169.

tools.name: ipdata_bulk_lookup
tools.title: Look up many IP addresses
tools.description: Look up up to 100 IP addresses in one call (paid ipdata plans only). Duplicates are removed first. Replies are a list in the same order, one entry per address. Each address uses 1 request of the daily quota (100 addresses = 100 requests). Use `fields` to keep the reply small. POST /bulk. The call is never retried.
